tableVerbalizerSpec.description: Defines the table verbalizer spec used to verbalize the tables.

tableDetectorSpec.description: Defines the table detector spec used to detect the tables.

numThreadsForVerbalization.description:
The number of threads to use for parallel verbalization of images for API-based models.
If it is a local visual language model, this is ignored since the verbalization will be performed serially.

bboxOverlapRatio.description: The page height ratio used to approximate title/ header bounding boxes. Default value is 0.1.

camelotKwargs.description:
Keyword arguments to pass to `camelot.read_pdf`. The default is dict(flavor='stream', row_tol=10).

- `row_tol`: row merging tolerance, higher value will lead to text spaced further apart to get merged.
- `flavor`: 'stream' for tables split by whitespace characters, 'lattice' for tables with explicit line segments.

See {@link https://camelot-py.readthedocs.io/en/master/user/how-it-works.html#lattice}
and {@link https://camelot-py.readthedocs.io/en/master/api.html#camelot.read_pdf} for more details.

disableTitleHeaderExtraction.description: Whether to extract table metadata such as title and header from the table.

splitLength.description: The maximum token length of a chunk

title: Defines the specs for the table parser used in {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.MultimodalPdf}.
